short_days: Keep Sunday/Friday UTC candles separately. Expected active M5 grid uses conventional Sunday17-Friday17 America/New_York Forex week with DST solely for data completeness. Missing active quotes invalidate D1. Holidays with unknown closure are conservatively invalid.
d1_pivots: Strict 2-left/2-right unique extrema, five valid consecutive expected-active D1 candles. Pivot known only after second right D1 close. No confirmation across invalid days.
d1_trend: Structure: latest two confirmed highs and latest two confirmed lows both rise=BUY, both fall=SELL, else neutral. EMA220: last closed valid D1 close above/below EMA220 after >=220 valid D1 bars. Intersection requires agreement. Latest expected-active closed D1 must be valid.
ema_limitation: One year is short for EMA220; min220 is availability only, not evidence of seed convergence. No prehistory invented.
levels: User selected first confirmed D1 swing then closed-D1 touch/rejection reactions. Zone fixed at seed price +/-0.20 ATR14 at confirmation. Later valid D1 intersects zone and closes strictly below lower edge for high resistance, above upper edge for low support. Reactions >=3 expected-active D1 bars apart, only after seed confirmation. Matching confirmed swings do not themselves increment count. Important from second/third reaction close. Numerical touch/separation rules provisional for visual approval.
level_lifetime: Track age from first pivot in expected-active D1 bars. Expire after 60 (alternative20). Close beyond far band invalidates level for NEW H1 contexts. Existing confirmed H1 context retains frozen snapshot. No reaction count is backdated.
h1: Only complete 12-M5 hours, contiguous current/previous H1. Trend and level must be known by H1 OPEN. BUY far edge=anchor+tolerance, SELL=anchor-tolerance. Breach buffer=0.05 lagged H1 ATR14. Wick: previous close inside and high/low beyond; recognized only after H1 close. Close: previous close inside and close beyond. Retest: close variant then 1..6 subsequent contiguous H1 touches band and closes again beyond far edge.
m5: Context lifetime 6 actual hours after H1 confirmation, continuous available M5; daily trend rechecked at signal. Local pivots strict2-left2-right, known before candidate M5 OPEN; freeze opposite BOS pivot at sweep. BUY sweeps local low then returns above, later closes above local high; SELL mirrored. Sweep buffer0.1 lagged M5 ATR14, BOS buffer0.05. BOS strictly after return bar; no OHLC intrabar-order assumption.
return_windows: 0: return in sweep candle. 1/2/3: first return 1..N subsequent continuous M5, excluding same-bar return. Nested late windows overlap; counts not independent.
simplified: First close crossing latest already confirmed local structure after H1 confirmation; no sweep requirement.
contexts: One H1 setup per level/direction/UTC day per H1 mode; first M5 confirmation per context/model. No maximum distance-to-daily-level filter yet; distance shown for visual approval.
selection_examples: Prefer reference then retest/wick/late-return/other strict configs, simplified only if fewer than five per direction. Chronological, one per date+level, no future PnL used. At least5 BUY+5 SELL if recognized examples exist. Never fabricate lacking examples.
charts: Only D1/H1 candles closed at signal and M5 bars through signal. Pivot marks only if confirmed by signal. Candidate entry is signal-side quote close, not promised fill; no post-signal outcome plotted or evaluated.
data_timestamp: UTC explicit; source bar-open semantics unverified and treated as a condition of all examples.
restricted_phase3: No SL/TP optimization, returns, win rates, capital/risk/drawdown simulation or news filter evaluation until user visually confirms models. Future plan reserved: one virtual position,1000GBP,0.5%/1%risk,10%drawdown cap.
